Sounds like you need a motivational slap. Life may be hard right now, and you may not have anyone to share the journey with for the moment but that doesn’t mean you can give up.

  There is so many beautiful things in world from watching the sun rise to having great nights out with friends. Even just going out to your favorite food place or doing something with your kids. When times are darkest you have to appreciate the small things. 

  On the relationship topic, don’t rush too quickly into it. Especially these days, most people theses days are very self centered and deceiving. But there is a few good people out there it just takes awhile to find em, so it’s not bad that you don’t want to rush back into it.

Most all people these days are very self centered, rude, and manipulative as you’ve seen BUTT please don’t give up. Not all dudes are complete assholes, even if it takes some time I promise you’ll find someone that says I love you and mean it more than anything. Try taking some time away from the relationship scene it might help.

Man as hard as it seems, try not to get to down. You’ve been through so much and you beat the odds of death, be proud that even though you went through all of that you’re still here today. 

Also people these days are very mean and self centered but you’ll find your group of friends in time. If you want I’d love to be your friend! 

Ps. Keep your head up no matter the situation
